business_summary: Western Copper and Gold Corporation, an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for gold, copper, silver, and molybdenum deposits. Its principal property is the Casino mineral property located in Yukon, Canada. The company was formerly known as Western Copper Corp. and changed its name to Western Copper and Gold Corporation in October 2011. Western Copper and Gold Corporation was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
business_summary_ko: 탐사 단계 회사인 Western Copper and Gold Corporation은 캐나다의 광물 자산 탐사 및 개발에 참여하고 있습니다. 금, 구리, 은, 몰리브덴 매장지를 탐색합니다. 주요 자산은 캐나다 유콘에 위치한 카지노 광물 자산입니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Western Copper Corp.로 알려져 있었으며 2011년 10월에 Western Copper and Gold Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. Western Copper and Gold Corporation은 2006년에 법인화되었으며 캐나다 밴쿠버에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
